goal: Trim surrounding whitespace and reject blank bookmark titles while preserving ownership, optimistic version checks and unchanged fields.
runtime: pure Java 17; no Spring container or external dependencies

acceptance.expect: Surrounding spaces are removed before persistence.
Null and blank titles reject without state or audit changes.
Only the owner can rename; ownership checks precede title validation.
Tags and saved sequence are unchanged; a successful change increments version and audit once.
A normalized no-op changes neither version nor audit.

assumptions: Titles use String.trim semantics; non-ASCII whitespace normalization is outside this example contract.
Authentication is upstream; this local model receives a synthetic caller reference.
Single-process in-memory synchronization only; no database or distributed concurrency claim.
